evidence: All candidates in an election who participate in Smartvote are asked the same set of questions, but depending on the locale they see translated versions of the questions. They can answer each question with either `yes', `rather yes', `rather no', or `no'. They can supplement each answer with a comment of at most 500 characters.

title: X-Stance: A Multilingual Multi-Target Dataset for Stance Detection
answer_short: The dataset includes annotations for stance towards political targets, with comments categorized as 'yes', 'rather yes', 'rather no', or 'no', and free-text comments to justify answers.
answer_rationale: The dataset is structured as a stance detection task where the question acts as the target and the comment as the input to be classified. The annotations are categorical responses ('yes', 'rather yes', 'rather no', 'no') and free-text comments for justification, as described in the introduction and data collection sections.
